caption: The video showcases a close-up, eye-level view of a dimpled glass mug filled with amber beer, topped by a mounded white foam head that rises above the rim. The background is flat gray, and bright rectangular reflections sit on the upper front of the glass while a curved glossy highlight appears on the right side of the liquid. The glass and background remain fixed in screen position. The foam head slowly settles, and its smooth creamy surface develops more distinct, larger bubbles across the top and sides. The overall height and outline of the mound above the rim stay largely constant, showing only a slight apparent lowering of the top edge. The boundary between the white foam and the amber liquid remains at a steady level inside the glass. Sparse small bubbles are visible within the liquid near the right side, with no large-scale movement of the beer itself.
